title: Sofía Vergara Is Recovering From Another Knee Surgery — Here's What She's Shared So Far
metaDescription: Sofía Vergara underwent another round of knee surgery and is recovering surrounded by friends. She hasn't explained why — but she has shared the aftermath.
altText: Health news illustration for: Sofía Vergara Is Recovering From Another Knee Surgery — Here's What She's Shared So Far
html:
Sofía Vergara is back on her feet — slowly — after another round of surgery on a knee that's clearly given her trouble before.

The 53-year-old actress was discharged from the hospital around July 26, after which she began posting recovery photos on social media. True to her public persona, Vergara leaned into the moment rather than hiding it, posting poolside pictures surrounded by friends with captions like "my favorite nurses ❤️❤️❤️" and later, "More post op love ❤️."

What she hasn't shared is why this particular surgery was necessary. This marks at least a second known procedure on the same knee, though Vergara has kept the medical specifics private, focusing her public updates instead on gratitude for the people helping her through recovery.

Fans flooded her posts with supportive comments, with one writing, "I'm happy your post operation is going so well. It's good to see how loved you are." It's a familiar pattern for celebrity health updates: the medical details stay vague, but the emotional tone — supported, surrounded, on the mend — comes through clearly.

For now, there's no confirmed timeline on when Vergara expects a full recovery, but the photos suggest someone who's choosing to recover in good company rather than out of the spotlight entirely.
